title: SADRACH'S KRING
creator: L. Adriaanse, Dienaar des Woords te Utrecht, afgezonden tot den Zendingsdienst te Poerworedjo
content: A Dutch account of the Javanese Christian congregations gathered around Sadrach, by a minister sent to the mission at Poerworedjo. The title page is printed twice (lines 68-76 and 86-99). Editorial matter: a 'Voorwoord' signed P. J. W. K., Utrecht, Zomermaand 1899, at lines 115-172. The author's 'Inleiding' runs from line 178 and is signed Poerworedjo, 20 Maart 1899, at line 509. Divisions: numbered chapters I to LXXXIX and a 'Naschrift'; chapter I begins at line 521 and the text ends at line 22030. The contents list ('Inhoud') is at lines 22033-22399. Chapters I-VII treat earlier Javanese congregations; Sadrach is named in the chapter headings from chapter VIII (line 2603).
flags: The second title page reads '1890' in the OCR at line 99; the first reads 1899 (lines 51 and 76). The author's title-page name is broken in the OCR on the first leaf.

Mixed voices: a note signed A. Remollino ends at line 1645.
